Overview

Oxnard is a city in CA with a population of 202,063. Strawberry fields and beaches between LA and Santa Barbara with coastal California prices. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 10a growing zone supports Hot — tropical and subtropical crops, year-round growing. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 273 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.0.
